query: InfiniteTalk produces black screen output after a wrapper regression in the prefetch feature.

desired.outcome: kijai reverted the change that broke prefetch; with latest commit InfiniteTalk works again (prefetch value 1 in workflow). Reporter also confirmed switching mode to multitalk resolved their variant.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests recognizing a wrapper-side prefetch regression (black frames despite normal logs) and fixing it by updating/pinning the node instead of reworking the workflow
